report.limitation: Explicit actual fresh-process execution; shared-request mode only reuses within this run. Original cases/policies are all evaluated. Duration and recorded environment consistency do not authenticate historical clocks, environment values or execution; read-only verification does not compare its caller environment to the original execution environment.
